# Understanding spatial patterns: how to measure and compare them

## Slides

The workshop slides are at <https://jakubnowosad.com/eon2026/>.

## Prerequisites

Participants are expected to have a recent version of R and an R IDE installed.

- R: <https://cloud.r-project.org/>
- RStudio: <https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop/#download>

Install the required packages from CRAN before working on the exercises.

```r
install.packages(c(
  "terra",
  "sf",
  "landscapemetrics",
  "motif",
  "dplyr",
  "tidyr"
))
```

## Exercises

Download the exercises repository as a ZIP file from <https://github.com/Nowosad/eon2026-exercises/archive/refs/heads/main.zip> and unpack it on your computer.
Then open the `.Rproj` file in RStudio and start working on the exercises.
